task_description: Build a greenfield MLB postseason information summary site for the Kiro University final exam: a React+TS (Vite) SPA that graphically shows postseason status (bracket/series/standings) with a win/loss prediction feature powered by Amazon Bedrock narratives. Backend is API Gateway + Lambda (TS) with DynamoDB caching of MLB Stats API data (seed fallback). AWS CDK (TS) provides one-command deploy. Includes Kiro steering files (University requirements + product/tech/structure) and a README. Deliverable is complete, buildable, synth-verified code; no live cdk deploy (AWS creds inactive this session).
